description: List content entries for a collection with advanced filtering, sorting, and pagination. Use the 'where' parameter for powerful queries. Read the 'query-reference' resource for full documentation on operators and examples.

count.description: If true, return only the count of matching entries: { count: N }

exclude.description: Comma-separated field names to exclude from response (e.g. 'content,excerpt')

first.description: If true, return only the first matching entry as a single object instead of an array

limit.description: Limit the number of results (ignored if paginate is set)

offset.description: Skip N results (requires limit to be set)

paginate.description: Enable pagination with N items per page. Returns paginated response with meta data. Overrides limit/offset.

sort.description: Sort by field:direction, comma-separated for multiple. Examples: 'created_at:desc', 'title:asc,created_at:desc'. Supports core columns (id, created_at, updated_at, published_at) and custom field names.

state.description: Filter by state: 'draft' or 'published'. Defaults to published entries.

where.description: Filter conditions as a nested object. Supports operators: eq, lt, lte, gt, gte, not, like, in, not_in, null, not_null, between, not_between. Simple: { "state": "published" }. With operators: { "price": { "lt": 50 }, "title": { "like": "news" } }. OR group: { "or": [{ "tags": "clearance" }, { "campaign": { "name": "Summer" } }] }. Relation filter: outer key = relation field on this collection; inner keys = field names on the related entry, e.g. { "author": { "name": { "eq": "John" } } }. Core columns (id, uuid, locale, state, created_at, updated_at, published_at) can be filtered directly.

name: list_entries
title: List Entries
